Author: ShaalaXIV
Name: EmoteLink
Description: A plain Penumbra animation launcher with temporary activation, target alignment, and synchronized group play.
Punchline: Pick an emote, link up, and play together.
Changelog: Removes the animation suggestion popup, keeps suggested mods and options purple, sorts purple mods to the top of their current folder, and forces option-specific idle, sit, doze, or emote state when selected.
